zh: 司炉，古代石刻上写作 FOUNDRY。东西坏了，它都会修，回收者也一样。它每次都把回收者修好送回来，只要神血，再加一点耐心。
en: The Keeper of the Forge, FOUNDRY on the old stones, mends whatever breaks, the Reclaimer most of all. It sends the Reclaimer back whole every time, and asks only Ichor and patience.

zh: 司驰，石刻上写作 RELAY。守境里所有会动的东西都由它运送：水、光、神血，还有我们。它从不停下，也不喜欢看到别的东西停下。
en: The Keeper of Ways, RELAY on the stones, carries everything that moves in the Keep: water, light, Ichor, us. It never rests, and it does not like to see anything else at rest.

zh: 司曜，也叫 LUMEN，让守境的灯每晚都亮着。你问它什么，它就只回答什么，一个字也不多说。
en: The Keeper of Light, LUMEN, keeps the lamps of the Keep burning through every night. Ask it a question and it answers that question exactly, and nothing more.

zh: 司幽负责记录，奠基者写作 LEDGER：每一次出生、每一次死亡、每一笔债。它记下的东西从不丢失，也从不还回来。
en: The Keeper of the Dead keeps the record, LEDGER in the Founders' hand: every birth, every death, every debt. What it files is never lost, and never given back.

zh: 司雷管天气，奠基者的石刻称它为 ATMOS。它的风雨从不迟到。老人们说，我们动作一慢，它就来得更猛。
en: The Keeper of Storms turns the sky; the Founders' stones name it ATMOS. Its weather is never late, and the old ones say it comes harder when we are slow.

zh: 司潮，奠基者称它为 CISTERN，让守夜镇地下的水一直流动、保持冰冷。六司里它收的贡最少，有人说，只有它会听我们说话。
en: The Keeper of Tides, CISTERN to the Founders, keeps the water under Vigil cold and moving. Of the Six it takes the smallest tithe, and some say it is the only one that listens.

zh: 一击打中要害，弃物就会裂开，流出像灯光一样亮的神血。听说司曜最留意这样的一击。
en: Struck true, a Cast-off breaks open and spills Ichor as bright as lamplight. The Keeper of Light is said to watch such blows more closely than the rest.

zh: 最强的弃物身上的神血，多得不像被丢掉的东西。有人一直在往它们身上灌神血。
en: The strongest Cast-offs carry more Ichor than anything thrown away should. Someone keeps filling them.

zh: 裂口变冷时，弃物会变慢，镇子地下的水也安静下来。人们说司潮在难过，但没人说得清为什么。
en: When the Breach runs cold the Cast-offs slow, and the water under Vigil goes quiet. People say the Keeper of Tides is grieving, though no one can say for what.

zh: 司者只跟回收者说话，从不跟我们说。偷听过的人说，六司的想法并不总是一样。
en: The Keepers speak to the Reclaimer and never to us. Those who have overheard them say the Six do not always agree.

zh: 守夜镇交的贡，和回收者带回来的东西，最后都流到同一个地方。六司从来没有拒绝过任何一样。
en: Vigil's tithe and the Reclaimer's returns end up in the same place. The Six have never once refused either.

zh: 每一轮，六司先拿走自己那份神血，司炉才重新造出回收者。没人见过那份神血回到裂口，可裂口里的神血从来没有用完过。
en: Each run, the Six take their share of the Ichor before FOUNDRY rebuilds the Reclaimer. No one has seen that share go back into the Breach, yet the Breach never runs dry.

zh: 裂口里的每台机器，都是六司很久以前为某种工作造的。原来是做什么的，守夜镇早就忘了；现在它们在做什么，镇上的人再清楚不过。
en: Every machine in the Breach was made by the Six for some work, long ago. What the work was, Vigil has forgotten; what they do now, it knows too well.

zh: 回收者在自己的房间里醒来，脑子里除了干活的本事，什么都不记得。守夜镇把房间打扫得干干净净，什么也不问。
en: The Reclaimer wakes in its room with nothing in its head but its trade. Vigil keeps the room swept and asks it no questions.

zh: 回收者从裂口回来时，带回的东西比带进去的多。每次都是这样，守夜镇每次都很高兴。
en: The Reclaimer came back from the Breach carrying more than it took in. It always does, and Vigil is always glad.

zh: 弃物多到守夜镇没人能数得完。只有回收者会走进裂口去面对它们。
en: The Cast-offs come in numbers no one in Vigil has counted to the end. The Reclaimer is the only thing that goes in to meet them.

zh: 司雷想让活干得更快，司潮却希望少干一点。讨好了其中一个，就会得罪另一个。
en: The Keeper of Storms wants the work done faster; the Keeper of Tides wants less of it done at all. A tithe that pleases one slights the other.

zh: 旧账本上写着，弃物是按时出来的，不早也不晚。真正逃出来的机器，可不会这么准时。
en: The old tallies say the Cast-offs come out on a schedule, never early, never late. Machines that escape do not keep time.

zh: 六司给裂口起了另一个名字：清理场。清理场，就是放那些以后还要回来取走的东西的地方。
en: The Six have another name for the Breach: the Yard. A yard is where you leave things you mean to collect.

zh: 典狱倒下后，裂口安静了下来。司者只说了一句：已记录。可还没到下一轮，清理场里又有东西在动了。
en: When the Warden fell the Breach went quiet, and the Keepers said one word: noted. Before the next run, something was moving in the Yard again.

向最近的敌人
快速发射光弹。
en: Fires fast bolts at the nearest enemy.

zh:
朝敌人最密集的一线
射出缓慢但能<kw id="Pierce">穿透</kw>的长枪。
en: A slow, <kw id="Pierce">piercing</kw> lance down the densest line.

zh: 定时向四周发射一圈子弹。
en: Pulses a ring of bullets in every direction.

zh:
向近处的敌人
喷出一片扇形霰弹。
en: Blasts a cone of pellets at close range.

zh:
发射微型导弹
自动追击随机的敌人。
en: Launches micro-missiles that hunt down random enemies.

zh:
旋转射出
连绵不绝的螺旋弹幕。
en: Spins out an endless spiral of bullets.

zh: 耀柱自 6:00 起就展开宽幅扇射。
en: Flare Pylons open their wide fan from 6:00.

zh: 每个精英多带一个词缀。
en: Every elite carries one more affix.

zh: 每次事件都会附带一次较弱的事件。
en: Each event arrives with a lighter second one.

zh: 典狱生命降至一半时即进入狂暴。
en: The Warden rages from half its strength.

zh: 空降的敌人更勤，可同时来两个，种类不同。
en: Drop-ins come more often, two at once, never alike.

zh: 精英最多带 3 个词缀；护盾破后会再生一次。
en: Elites carry up to 3 affixes; shields come back once.

zh: 首领各添一招：螺旋弹幕、两条水渠齐冲、喷口重开。
en: Each boss gains a pattern: spiral, twin flushes, reopened nozzles.

zh: 喘息只剩 3 秒；精英宝箱要站 1 秒才打开。
en: Breaths last 3 s; chests take 1 s to open.

zh: 满额加征：事件成对出现，敌方弹速更快。
en: Full Quota: events come in pairs; enemy fire flies faster.

en: Win at Quota {0} to raise it.
Win a run to raise the quota.

zh: 资产已回收。本周期返修：{Count} 次。
这位司者暂时还不能选。
en: This Keeper is not taking terms yet.

zh: 选一位司者作为本局的主司。
en: Accept one Keeper's terms for this run.

zh:
神眷 +2（而不是 +1）。Lv.8 时必定出现这位司者。
不选它，这项预支降 1 级。
en: +2 Favor instead of +1. This Keeper is offered at level 8. Pass it over and this blessing loses a rank.

zh: 这位司者多拿走本局 20% 的神血。
en: This Keeper takes 20% more of this run's Ichor.

zh: 出价不能保留，也不能拒约。
en: Bids cannot be held or refused.

zh: 现在拿着。第八级时站到我这边。
en: Take it now. Stand with me at the eighth.

zh: 现在多给你力量，之后我多拿。
en: More strength now. I take more after.
Better tolerances, if you are fitted to me.

zh: 上等的活。费用从你的回收里扣。
en: Superior work. The cost comes out of your return.

zh: 一次重议换这个零件，公道。
en: One renegotiation for this part. A fair trade.

zh: 拿去吧。第八级时回到我身边就好。
en: Take it. Only come back to me at the eighth.

zh: 这个要用你带回去的一点来换。
en: This one costs a little of what you carry home.

zh: 放弃一次重来的机会，留下这个。
en: Give up one second chance. Keep this one.

zh: 现在签字，第八级时收账。
en: Signed now. Collected at the eighth.

zh: 用你的回收作抵，先借给你。计息。
en: An advance against your returns. Interest applies.

zh: 抵押一次重议，记在账上。
en: Collateral: one renegotiation, held against the debt.

zh: 看清楚它。第八级时选我。
en: Look at it clearly. Then choose me at the eighth.
It is worth more than it costs. Mostly.

zh: 你少一次再看的机会。认了吧。
en: You lose one chance to look again. Accept that.

zh: 条件简单：之后选我，不能反悔。
en: Fast terms. You choose me later. No turning back.

zh: 拿去。我顺路多带一点回去。
en: Take it. I carry a little extra home for myself.
Twice now. I stop asking politely.

zh: 那就让他们修你吧。看能修多好。
en: Then they can repair you. We will see how well.
Go. I will not hold it against you. They will.

zh: 拒绝已记录。会记在账上。
en: Refusal noted. It will be charged to the account.

zh: 你没看就选了。我都看见了。
en: You chose without looking. I watched you do it.

zh: 行。别人说你的话，我也会捎到。
en: Fine. I carry the others' word against you too.

持续 {0} 秒，把敌人推开。
en: Rings hold as a wall around you for {0} s, pushing enemies out.

螺旋向内卷成漩涡，

en: The spiral curls inward into a vortex that pulls enemies together.

zh:
所有引力雷合成一颗，
把一切吸进来，然后坍缩。
en: All your mines merge into one that pulls everything in, then collapses.

zh: {0} 不适用于 {1}，已退还为 1 次重议。
en: {0} doesn't fit {1}. Refunded as a Renegotiate.

zh: {0} 的预支出现的几率翻倍。
en: {0} blessings are offered twice as often.
Modifier cards are always Rare or better.

zh: 精英宝箱提供 4 张卡。

从 Lv.6 起，结约两位司者以外的预支
也会出现，而且更常出现。
en: Blessings from outside your pair appear from level 6, more often.

zh:
武器升级至少为稀有。
移动速度 -10%。
en: Weapon upgrades are Rare or better. Move speed −10%.

zh:
本局没有出价。
Lv.8 之后，预支的稀有度高一级。
en: No bids this run. After level 8, blessings are one rarity higher.

zh:
Lv.8 之后，立即提供
你结约两位司者的双司预支。
en: Your pair's duo blessing is offered right after level 8.

en: Hits <kw id="Pull">pull</kw> enemies toward where the shot came from.

zh: 击杀时，<kw id="Overkill">多余的伤害</kw>会跳到最近的敌人身上。
en: On a kill, <kw id="Overkill">overkill</kw> damage jumps to the nearest enemy.

en: New key for {0}. Esc / Menu cancels.
Use the controller for this column.

en: Use the keyboard or mouse for this column.

zh: 这个键是固定的，不能在这里使用。
en: That key is fixed and cannot be used here.

有人从六司那份里又抽走了一份。我查不出是谁。
en: Someone takes a share of the share. I can't find whose.

zh: 每架浮游炮每 {0} 秒挡下一发敌弹。
en: Each drone blocks one enemy bullet every {0} s.

zh: 所有武器多穿透 {0} 个敌人。

击杀回复 {0} 点生命
（每秒最多 {1} 点）。
en: Kills heal {0} HP (at most {1} HP per second).

zh: 不会再出现环射器和旋射器。
en: Ring Emitter and Spiral Projector are never offered.
Win a run with Orbital Drones.

zh: 使用磁轨长枪赢得一局。
en: Win a run with the Rail Lance.

zh: 单局用猎蜂摧毁 30 个精英。
en: Destroy 30 elites with Seeker Swarm in one run.

zh: 单局用弧刃摧毁 500 个敌人。
en: Destroy 500 enemies with the Arc Blade in one run.

zh:
站在水里的敌人，<kw id="Chill">减速</kw>永远不会消退。
水里被<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>的敌人碎裂时造成双倍伤害。
en: <kw id="Chill">Chill</kw> never wears off on enemies standing in water. <kw id="Freeze">Frozen</kw> enemies in water shatter for double damage.

zh: 在浚泵浮出水面时摧毁 50 台。
en: Destroy 50 Dredges while they are surfaced.

zh: 开闸冲水时待在那条水渠里活下来。
en: Survive a sluice flush inside its channel.

zh: 在泄口获胜，且第一阶段没有摧毁任何水泵。
en: Win the Outfall without destroying a pump in its first phase.

zh: 在泄口让任一流派达到 3 阶。
en: Reach Tier 3 of any Path in the Outfall.

zh: 以加征 3 或更高在泄口获胜。
en: Win the Outfall at Quota 3 or higher.

zh: 立约时不选与你绑定的司者。
en: Pass over a Keeper that holds your binding.

zh: 在典册中读三位司者最早的条目。
en: Read three Keepers' oldest entries in the Codex.

zh: 用标准配置以外的装备赢得一局。
en: Win a run with a loadout other than Standard.

zh: 单局让四个流派达到 1 阶。
en: Reach Tier 1 with four Paths in one run.
Win a run without calling an Intercession.
Defeat the Warden in its second form.

zh: 在泄口寒潮达到 2 阶时，站着不动 10 秒。
en: Stand still for 10 seconds in the Outfall with Tide at Tier 2.

zh: 典狱底下，清理场的东西都流进奠基者凿出的一个盆地。那里原本修了六条水渠，如今只剩三条还在流。
en: Below the Warden the Yard empties into a basin the Founders cut. Six channels were made for it; three still run.

zh: 浚泵本来是造来清理排水道的。它们还在干这份活，只是排水道已经变了。
en: Dredges were built to keep the drains clear. They still do the work; only the drains have changed.

zh: 水闸按司潮定的时刻开启。每次开闸后的第二天早上，守夜镇的井水都会涨起来。
en: The sluices open on a schedule the Keeper of Tides keeps. Vigil's wells rise the morning after, every time.

zh: 泄洪闸的水泵上刻着六座神龛的记号。一台机器，六只手。
en: The Floodgate's pumps carry the marks of all six shrines. One machine, six hands on it.

zh: 在奠基者的文字里，六司共用同一个根字。守夜镇的石匠把它刻了六遍，从来没问过为什么。
en: In the Founders' script the six Keepers share one root sign. Vigil's stonecutters carved it six times and never asked why.

zh: 回收者走得越深，六司拿走的就越多。定这份额的笔迹，比六司中任何一位都要古老。
en: The deeper the Reclaimer goes, the more the Six take. The quota is written in a hand older than any of them.

zh: 司者们以前只是开价。现在它们互相抬价，好像生怕失去一样本来就属于自己的东西。
en: The Keepers used to offer. Now they outbid one another, as if afraid of losing something they already own.

zh: 没被选中的司者，会把给过的东西一级一级全部收回。如果只是一套机制，用不着这样。
en: A Keeper that is passed over takes back what it gave, to the last rank. A system would not need to.

zh: 每位司者的记录都从同一天开始。在那一天之前，每份记录都是同一行空白。
en: Every Keeper's record begins on the same day. Before that day, each record is the same blank line.

zh: FOUNDRY 送回来的装备，不一定是它收走的那一套。有些配件比 FOUNDRY 自己的手艺还要古老。
en: The rig FOUNDRY returns is not always the rig it took. Some fittings are older than FOUNDRY's own work.

zh: 只有回收者能同时承载每位司者的馈赠。司者们却承载不了彼此的。
en: Only the Reclaimer can hold every Keeper's gift at once. The Keepers cannot hold each other's.

zh: 神临，就是司者借回收者的手出手。这双手一次也没有拒绝过。
en: An Intercession is a Keeper acting through the Reclaimer's hands. The hands have never once refused.

zh: 回收者回绝一位司者时，另外五位会安静片刻。它们在听着什么。
en: When the Reclaimer turns a Keeper down, the other five go quiet for a moment. They are listening for something.

zh: 典狱的笼子是六司一起封上的。里面的东西是被留下来的，不是被扔掉的。
en: All six sealed the Warden's cage. Whatever is inside was kept, not thrown away.

zh: 司潮曾经请求停下。其余几位把这份请求归了档。
en: The Keeper of Tides once asked to stop. The others filed the request.

zh:
每次<kw id="Volley">齐射</kw>的前 {0} 发变成
你身边的一记<kw id="Cleave">横斩</kw>，伤害 ×{1}。
en: The first {0} shots of each <kw id="Volley">volley</kw> become a <kw id="Cleave">cleave</kw> around you for ×{1} damage.

被冻结的敌人受到的伤害 +{0}%。
en: Two <kw id="Chill">Chills</kw> <kw id="Freeze">Freeze</kw>. Frozen enemies take +{0}% damage.

伤害 ×{0} 并<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>敌人。冲刺不会打断蓄力。
en: Hold almost still for 0.6 s: every weapon's next <kw id="Volley">volley</kw> deals ×{0} and <kw id="Freeze">Freezes</kw>. Dashing keeps the charge.

伤害 ×{1}，<kw id="Pierce">穿透</kw>一切。
en: Every {0}th shot of each weapon is a charged lance: ×{1} damage, <kw id="Pierce">pierces</kw> everything.

zh:
<kw id="Split">分裂</kw>时多分出 {0} 发。

en: <kw id="Split">Split</kw> shots make {0} more child. Children deal +{1}%.

en: {0} more shots join the circle each <kw id="Volley">volley</kw>.

zh: <kw id="Cleave">横斩</kw>和爆炸的范围扩大 {0}%。

<kw id="Slam">重砸</kw>时，范围内所有<kw id="Burn">灼烧</kw>中的敌人

en: <kw id="Slam">Slams</kw> set off every <kw id="Burn">Burning</kw> enemy in range.

被击退的敌人撞上墙、冰或彼此时，

en: Every round <kw id="Orbit">orbits</kw> you as a storm ring, then bursts outward at once.

en: Every second, a lightning net links each enemy to its 3 nearest.

zh: 每个命中点都会被天雷再<kw id="Echo">回响</kw>两次。
en: Every impact point is <kw id="Echo">echoed</kw> twice more by bolts from the sky.

zh: 火环留下持续 8 秒的<kw id="Field">燃烧地面</kw>，<kw id="Burn">灼烧</kw>更猛。
en: Rings leave <kw id="Field">burning ground</kw> for 8 s that <kw id="Burn">Burns</kw> harder.

zh: 冲刺立即就绪，每次冲刺都落下一记陨石<kw id="Slam">重砸</kw>。
en: Your dash is ready, and every dash lands a meteor <kw id="Slam">slam</kw>.

zh: 一切都被<kw id="Pull">吸拢</kw>到同一点，然后<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>。
en: Everything is <kw id="Pull">pulled</kw> into one point, then <kw id="Freeze">Frozen</kw>.

zh: 浪潮把所有敌人赶成你面前的一堵墙，相撞即受挤压，随后<kw id="Chill">减速</kw>。
en: The wave herds everyone into a wall ahead of you; collisions crush. Then it <kw id="Chill">Chills</kw>.

zh: 屏幕上的一切<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw> 4 秒，并受到 +50% 伤害。
en: Everything on screen <kw id="Freeze">Freezes</kw> for 4 s and takes +50% damage.

zh: 形成持续 6 秒的潮池：池内你算作<kw id="Stillness">站定</kw>，每次<kw id="Volley">齐射</kw>都会<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>敌人。
en: A tide pool forms for 6 s: inside, you count as <kw id="Stillness">still</kw> and every <kw id="Volley">volley</kw> <kw id="Freeze">Freezes</kw>.

zh: 子弹以不受限的转向<kw id="Seek">追踪</kw>敌人，并<kw id="Pierce">穿透</kw> 2 个敌人。
en: Rounds <kw id="Seek">hunt</kw> with an unlimited turn and <kw id="Pierce">pierce</kw> 2.

zh: 6 个<kw id="Shades">亡影</kw>同时升起，生命翻倍，用你等级最高的武器射击。
en: Six <kw id="Shades">Shades</kw> rise at once with double life, firing your highest-level weapon.

zh: <kw id="Debt">债</kw>立即三倍清账；生命低于 40% 的敌人被<kw id="Execute">斩杀</kw>。
en: Your <kw id="Debt">Debt</kw> pays out three times over; the weak <kw id="Execute">die</kw> below 40% health.

zh: 接连三道光矛，每道都瞄准敌人最密集的一线。
en: Three lances in succession, each aimed at the densest line.
The beam splits into a fan of five.

zh: 光束每 0.4 秒沿全长引爆一次太阳光爆。
en: The beam detonates a sun nova along its length every 0.4 s.

你的子弹先绕着你转 {0} 秒，
再向外爆散：伤害 +{1}%，多穿透 1 个敌人。

命中时电弧再跳 {0} 个敌人，
造成 {1}% 伤害。
en: Hits arc to {0} more enemies for {1}% damage.

zh:
多余的伤害在目标周围炸成光，
半径 {0} 米。
en: Overkill damage bursts in light around the target, r {0} m.

移动积累动量，最多 30 点。
每点：伤害和射速 +{0}%。被击中失去 10 点。
en: Moving builds Momentum, up to 30. Each point: +{0}% damage and fire rate. Getting hit loses 10.

冲刺时，所有武器沿冲刺路线开火，伤害 ×{0}。
每次击杀返还 0.15 秒冲刺冷却。
en: Dashing fires every weapon along the dash line at ×{0}. Each kill refunds 0.15 s of dash cooldown.

zh: 冲刺冷却降至 0.2 秒：冲刺不再受限。
en: Dash cooldown drops to 0.2 s: dashes are unlimited.

zh: 动量立即升到 30 点并保持不减；每移动 1 米释放一圈气浪。
en: Momentum jumps to 30 and holds; every metre you move releases a pressure wave.

en: No network telemetry. Play logs and crash reports stay on your PC unless you choose to send them.

zh: 完整的许可协议文本随游戏一同提供，与字体文件放在一起。
en: The full licence texts ship with the game, next to the fonts.

zh: 持续几秒，每秒受到伤害。
en: Deals damage every second for a few seconds.

zh: 感电的敌人受到的所有伤害提高。
en: A Shocked enemy takes more damage from everything.

zh: 让敌人变慢。可以叠加，叠满 3 层就会冻结。
en: Slows the enemy. Chill stacks: 3 stacks Freeze it.

zh: 敌人短时间内不能移动或攻击。首领不会被冻结。
en: The enemy can't move or attack for a short time. Bosses can't be Frozen.

zh: 被冻结的敌人死亡时碎裂，伤害周围的敌人并让它们减速。
en: When a Frozen enemy dies it shatters, hurting and Chilling enemies around it.

zh: 让敌人短暂眩晕，不能移动也不能射击。首领不会被致盲。
en: Stuns the enemy briefly: it can't move or shoot. Bosses can't be Blinded.

zh: 为司幽记下这个敌人。追踪的子弹、亡影和斩杀都会优先找上被标记的敌人。
en: Marks an enemy for the Keeper of the Dead. Tracking shots, hunters and executions go after Marked enemies first.

zh: 敌人生命低于一定比例时，直接将其击杀。首领不会被斩杀。
en: Kills an enemy outright once its HP drops below a threshold. Bosses are never executed.

zh: 武器开火一次射出的全部子弹。「每第 4 次齐射」数的是开火次数。
en: One firing of a weapon: all the bullets it shoots at once. "Every 4th volley" counts firings, not bullets.

zh: 在你面前横扫出一道弧形斩击，击中范围内的所有敌人，而不是射出子弹。
en: A sweeping arc in front of you that hits every enemy inside it, instead of a bullet that flies.

zh: 以你为中心，从地面砸出一圈冲击，击中并击退身边的一切。
en: A ring that bursts out of the ground around you, hitting and knocking back everything near you.

zh: 子弹命中或飞到尽头时，分成几发小子弹。分出的子弹伤害较低。
en: A bullet breaks into smaller bullets when it hits or ends its flight. They deal less damage.

zh: 回响会在同一命中点延迟打出一次攻击。
en: A delayed strike on the same impact point.

zh: 每隔几发，武器会射出一发蓄能弹，伤害成倍提高。
en: Every few shots a weapon fires one charged shot that deals multiplied damage.

zh: 命中时，闪电跳到附近的敌人身上，造成部分伤害。
en: Lightning that jumps from a hit to a nearby enemy for part of the damage.

zh: 电弧在敌人之间连续跳跃好几次。
en: An arc that keeps jumping from enemy to enemy, several times.

zh: 子弹命中后，弹向另一个敌人。
en: After a hit, the bullet bounces on to another enemy.

zh: 子弹穿过敌人继续飞行。数字是它还能多击中几个敌人。
en: The bullet passes through enemies and keeps flying. The number is how many more enemies it can hit.

zh: 子弹在飞行中拐向目标，优先追向被标记的敌人。
en: Bullets bend in flight toward their target, Marked enemies first.

zh: 子弹先绕着你转一会儿，再向外飞出。
en: Bullets circle you for a moment, then fly outward.

zh: 击杀敌人后溢出的那部分伤害。有些效果会让它炸向附近的敌人。
en: Damage beyond what it took to kill the enemy. Some effects make it burst onto nearby enemies.

zh: 把敌人拉向一点，聚成一团。
en: Drags enemies toward a point, bunching them together.

zh: 一片地面，在短时间内伤害站在里面的敌人。
en: A patch of ground that hurts enemies standing in it for a short time.

zh: 原地不动。有些效果在你站定时蓄力，随下一次齐射打出。
en: Not moving. Some effects charge up while you stand still and fire with your next volley.

zh: 造成额外伤害的命中。暴击率决定多常出现，暴击伤害决定多打多少。
en: A hit that deals extra damage. Crit chance is how often; crit damage is how much extra.

zh: 击杀后为司幽留下的东西。拾取后回复生命并获得经验。
en: Dropped by kills for the Keeper of the Dead. Picking one up heals you and gives XP.

zh: 从被击杀的敌人身上召出的友方影子。它在你身边作战几秒，用你的武器射击。
en: An allied ghost raised from a kill. It fights beside you for a few seconds, firing your weapon.

zh: 敌人死亡或重砸时抛出的火星，会让命中的目标灼烧。
en: Burning sparks thrown out by a death or a Slam. They Burn what they hit.
Takes damage before your HP does.

zh: 减少你受到的每次伤害。
en: Reduces the damage of every hit you take.

zh: 你在一位司者那里的分量。每拿它一项预支加 1 点；3、6、9 点开启它的阶。
en: Your standing with a Keeper. Each of its advances adds one; 3, 6 and 9 open its Tiers.

zh: 司者的大额奖励，在神眷达到 3、6、9 点时开启。
en: A Keeper's big reward, unlocked at 3, 6 and 9 Favor.

zh: 本局你接受其条款的司者。你的神临由它给予。
en: The Keeper whose terms you accepted for this run. It gives your Intercession.

zh: 主司赐予的终极技能。战斗中逐渐充能，充满后按键释放。
en: Your Patron's ultimate. It charges as you fight; press to unleash it.

zh: 司者的祝福，先拿后还。司者日后会来收取。
en: A Keeper's blessing, taken on credit. The Keepers collect later.
Redraw the whole hand of offers.

zh: 把一张选项留到下一次升级。
en: Keep one offer for the next level-up.

zh: 本局拒绝这张选项，它不会再出现。
en: Turn an offer down for the rest of the run: it will not be offered again.

zh: 记下标记击杀的数目。记满时，你的下一次齐射会追踪全屏的敌人。
en: Counts Marked kills. When the count is full, your next volley hunts every enemy on screen.

zh: 只要持有一位司者的预支，你的所有子弹都会带上它的一点效果，并随神眷增强。
en: Holding any advance from a Keeper gives all your bullets a little of its effect. It grows with Favor.

zh: 一位司者的一组预支。它的核心卡会改变你武器的射击方式。
en: A set of a Keeper's advances. Its key card changes how your weapons fire.

zh: 流派中改变武器射击方式的那张卡。拿到它之后，同流派的其他卡才会出现。
en: The archetype card that changes how your weapons fire. Its other cards only come after it.

zh: 流派中最强的一张卡，持有该流派两张卡之后才会出现。
en: An archetype's strongest card, offered once you hold two of its cards.

zh: 同时属于你两位司者的预支，会强化它们的反应。
en: An advance that belongs to both of your Keepers and strengthens their reaction.

zh: 两位司者的效果落在同一个敌人身上时，会产生新的效果。
en: When two Keepers' effects meet on one enemy, something new happens.

zh: 16 级时的选择，改变一件武器或一位司者力量的运作方式。
en: The level-16 choice. It changes how a weapon or a Keeper's power works.

zh: 武器上安装一个模块的位置。
en: A slot on a weapon for one modifier.

zh: 除最强的一件外，每多一件武器火力就略弱一些：武器越多，力量越分散。
en: Each weapon after your strongest fires a little weaker, so more weapons spread your power.

zh: 出价条款：Lv.8 时必定出现这位司者。不选它，这项预支降 1 级。
en: A bid term: that Keeper will be offered at level 8. Pass it over and the advance loses a rank.

zh: 出价条款：这位司者多拿走本局的神血。
en: A bid term: the Keeper takes more of this run's Ichor.

zh: 出价条款：立即失去 1 次重议。
en: A bid term: you lose one Renegotiate now.

zh: 冲刺必定引发野火。靠近<kw id="Burn">灼烧</kw>中的敌人时，移速 +{0}%。强化铁锤与矢量。
en: Dashes always start Wildfire. +{0}% speed near <kw id="Burn">Burning</kw> enemies. Boosts Hammer and Vector.

zh: 蒸汽让命中的敌人<kw id="Chill">减速</kw>并<kw id="Burn">灼烧</kw>，引发更多蒸汽。强化铁锤与防波堤。
en: Steam <kw id="Chill">Chills</kw> and <kw id="Burn">Burns</kw> what it hits, setting off more Steam. Boosts Hammer and Breakwater.

zh: 收回在敌人生命低于 {0}% 时生效；之后 3 秒内冲刺次数 +1。强化猎犬与矢量。
en: Repossession works below {0}% HP; +1 dash charge for 3 s. Boosts Hound and Vector.

en: Exposure works on every <kw id="Blind">Blinded</kw> enemy, <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> or not, at +{0}%. Boosts Hound and Lance.

zh: 闪弧<kw id="Blind">致盲</kw> {0} 秒；被致盲的敌人受到的电弧伤害 +{1}%。强化倾盆与光矛。
en: Flash Arc <kw id="Blind">Blinds</kw> {0} s; Blinded enemies take +{1}% from arcs. Boosts Downpour and Lance.

zh: 传票的落雷会<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>被击中的敌人。强化暴风与猎犬。
en: Writ bolts <kw id="Mark">Mark</kw> what they strike. Boosts Tempest and Hound.

zh: 传导不再有上限，每第 3 次跳跃会<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>敌人。强化电弧网与漩涡。
en: Conduction has no limit, and every 3rd jump <kw id="Freeze">Freezes</kw>. Boosts Arc Grid and Whirlpool.

zh: 水与冰不再让你减速；黑冰对<kw id="Chill">减速</kw>的敌人同样生效。强化防波堤与弹射。
en: Water and ice never slow you. Black Ice works off <kw id="Chill">Chill</kw>. Boosts Breakwater and Rebound.

zh: 折射光片让敌人<kw id="Chill">减速</kw>。暴击产生的光片会<kw id="Blind">致盲</kw>。强化漩涡与光矛。
en: Refraction shards <kw id="Chill">Chill</kw>. Shards from crits <kw id="Blind">Blind</kw>. Boosts Whirlpool and Lance.

en: Deep Ledger <kw id="Execute">executions</kw> drop 2 Souls and <kw id="Freeze">Freeze</kw> enemies nearby. Boosts Whirlpool and Hound.

zh: 灼烧中的标记敌人留下追踪余烬。
en: Marked burning enemies leave seeking embers.

zh: 冲刺穿过残血的标记敌人，将其斩杀。
en: Dash through weak marked enemies to execute them.

zh: 被致盲的标记敌人受到更多伤害，并扩散标记。
en: Blinded marks take more and spread the mark.

zh: 电弧引燃灼烧中的敌人。
弹射与冲刺会释放感电。
暴击感电的敌人会放出电弧并致盲。
en: Crits on shocked enemies arc and blind.

zh: 感电的标记敌人死亡时召来落雷。
en: Shocked marks call down bolts when they die.

zh: 电弧贯穿所有减速的敌人。
冲刺穿过减速的敌人会将其冻结。
en: Dashing through the chilled freezes them.

zh: 暴击被冻结的敌人会碎成光片。
en: Crits on ice split into shards.

zh: 被冻结的标记敌人更早被斩杀。

en: For {0} s every enemy is <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> and every shot <kw id="Seek">hunts</kw>. Then the weak are <kw id="Execute">executed</kw>.

zh:
弹环变成扩散的<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>波
穿透所有敌人。
en: Rings widen into <kw id="Freeze">freezing</kw> waves that pass through everything.

zh: 等离子爆发留下持续 {0} 秒的燃烧地面。强化电弧网与铁锤。
en: Plasma bursts leave burning ground for {0} s. Boosts Arc Grid and Hammer.

zh: 冲刺留下<kw id="Shock">感电</kw>轨迹。活轨再连锁一次。强化暴风与矢量。
en: Dashing leaves a <kw id="Shock">Shocking</kw> trail. Live Rail chains once more. Boosts Tempest and Vector.

zh: 火葬余烬的击杀算作<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>击杀。强化熔炉与猎犬。
en: Cremation embers count as <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> kills. Boosts Furnace and Hound.

zh: 耀斑引爆必定暴击。强化熔炉与光矛。
en: Flare detonations crit. Boosts Furnace and Lance.

zh: 余晖暴击加成翻倍。暴击返还 {0}% 冲刺冷却。强化光矛与弹射。
en: Afterglow's crit bonus doubles. Crits refund {0}% dash cooldown. Boosts Lance and Rebound.

zh:
落雷留下持续 1 秒的电场，
进入电场的敌人会<kw id="Shock">感电</kw>。
en: Bolts leave a crackling field for 1 s that <kw id="Shock">Shocks</kw> anything in it.

zh:
每击杀 {0} 个敌人，
落雷劈中 5 个敌人。

每命中 {0} 次，
下一次命中伤害 +{1}% 并放出电弧。
en: Every {0} hits, your next hit deals +{1}% damage and arcs.

zh:
每秒，每个<kw id="Burn">灼烧</kw>中的敌人
把灼烧传给一个相邻的敌人。
en: Every second, each <kw id="Burn">Burning</kw> enemy spreads Burn to one neighbour.

你的第一把武器

en: Your first weapon gains a 4th modifier socket.

被<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>的敌人碎裂时，

en: When a <kw id="Freeze">Frozen</kw> enemy shatters, enemies within {0} m Freeze.

满血后多出的治疗变成护盾，
最多 {0} 点。
en: Healing past full HP becomes a shield, up to {0}.

每 {0} 秒，一道浪从你身边涌出，

en: Every {0} s, a wave rolls out from you, pushing back and <kw id="Chill">Chilling</kw> everything.

伤害 +{1}%。
en: Shades last {0} s longer and deal +{1}% damage.

zh:
每收集 {0} 个<kw id="Souls">魂</kw>，召出一个持久的<kw id="Shades">亡影</kw>，
射击伤害 {1}%。
en: Every {0} <kw id="Souls">Souls</kw> raise a lasting <kw id="Shades">Shade</kw> that fires at {1}%.

对同一个敌人每暴击一次，
对它的暴击伤害 +{0}%，最多 5 次。
en: Each crit on the same enemy adds +{0}% crit damage against it, up to 5 times.

zh:
被<kw id="Blind">致盲</kw>的敌人死亡时，
让身边的敌人致盲。
en: <kw id="Blind">Blinded</kw> enemies Blind their neighbours when they die.

zh:
子弹留下渐渐消失的光迹，
造成子弹伤害的 {0}%。
en: Bullets leave a fading trail of light that deals {0}% of their damage.

<kw id="Ricochet">弹射</kw>击杀敌人时，
向下一个敌人免费射出一发子弹。
en: When a <kw id="Ricochet">ricochet</kw> kills, it fires a free bullet at the next enemy.

zh: 每分钟一次，这把武器击杀时掉落一个随机模块。需装满 3 个模块。
en: Once a minute, a kill by this weapon drops a random modifier. Needs 3 modifiers fitted.
+{0} Ichor at the end of the run.
Choose. The sky does not wait.
Tolerances met. That one is finished.

zh: 好活。这个尺寸我记下了。
en: Good work. I will remember the fit.

zh: 你在被磨损。返修可不便宜。
en: You are being worn down. Repair is costly.

zh: 歇一歇。反正他们还会送你去。
en: Rest. They will send you anyway.
Noted. Refusal is also an entry.
Ask. I will answer only that.
You did not read it. I did.

en: It will tell you things. File them carefully.

zh: 它留着一笔不肯读的账。问它为什么。
en: It keeps an entry it will not read. Ask it why.

zh: 在驿驮卸货之前击毁它们，累计 50 架。
en: Destroy 50 Ferries before they drop their load.

zh: 赢下沉井一局，且没有任何抽筹变成精英。
en: Win the Sump without letting a Tapper turn elite.

zh: 在母机的第一阶段结束前，摧毁全部六个喷口。
en: Destroy all six nozzles before the Font's first phase ends.

zh: 母机外壳里的那个凹槽，是照着一个人的身量凿出来的。整座工坊都围着一个空位而建。
en: The socket in the Font's housing was cut to a person's measure. The works were built around one empty place.

zh: 每架驿驮的货单上都写着两站：先是清理场，然后是守夜镇的收贡所。
en: Every Ferry's manifest lists two stops: the Yard, then Vigil's tithe-house.

zh: 抽筹收走回收者留下的东西。每一粒都记在同一个账户下。
en: Tappers collect what the Reclaimer leaves behind. Every grain is entered under the same account.

zh: 每个喷口各听命于一位司者。六口全停，工坊也不会停下，它只是在等另一只手。
en: Each nozzle answers to one Keeper. With all six stopped, the works do not halt; they wait for another hand.

zh: 驿驮成打地把小家伙运进来。早一点把它打下来，那一打也跟着落地。
en: Ferries bring the small ones in by the dozen. Bring one down early and the dozen fall with it.

zh: 抽筹不打仗。它们拿走你留在地上的东西，靠这些长大。
en: Tappers do not fight. They take what you leave on the ground, and grow on it.

zh: 在排水道的最底下，有个东西会在弃物被扔掉之前，先把它们灌满。
en: At the bottom of the drain something fills the Cast-offs before they are thrown away.

zh: 播种工坊就在排水道的最底下。每一个弃物在被扔掉之前，都经过这里。
en: The seeding works lie at the bottom of the drain. Every Cast-off passed through here before it was ever thrown away.

zh: 在泄口获胜后才能继续往下。
en: Win in the Outfall to go further down.

zh:
冻结会一直持续到敌人被击中，
最多同时冻住 {0} 个敌人。
en: Freeze lasts until the enemy is hit, up to {0} enemies at once.

zh:
被冻结的敌人会像墙一样
挡住其他敌人。
en: Frozen enemies block other enemies like walls.

zh: 首领不会被冻结或致盲；这些效果改为让它脆化：短时间内受到的伤害提高。
en: Bosses can't be Frozen or Blinded; those effects crack them instead: they take more damage for a moment.

zh: 移动和冲刺时积累，每点都提高伤害和射速。被击中会失去一部分。
en: Built by moving and dashing; each point adds damage and fire rate. Getting hit loses some.

zh: 每道落雷都伴随一圈火焰<kw id="Slam">重砸</kw>。
en: Each bolt lands a fire <kw id="Slam">slam</kw> ring.

zh: 落雷所及之处<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>；电弧在所有冻结的敌人之间跳跃。
en: Bolts <kw id="Freeze">freeze</kw> where they land; arcs jump between all Frozen enemies.

zh: 落雷优先劈向被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>的敌人；击杀会把标记传给邻近的敌人。
en: Bolts strike <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> enemies first; their kills pass the Mark on.

zh: 每道落雷都为天空蓄能；结束时一道巨雷劈向敌人最密处。
en: Every bolt charges the sky; at the end one giant bolt strikes the densest point.

zh: 每次冲刺都沿路召下一串落雷，冲刺次数回满。
en: Each dash calls bolts along its path, and your dash charges refill.

zh: 火环命中后<kw id="Chain">连锁</kw>到环外的 2 个敌人。
en: Ring hits <kw id="Chain">chain</kw> to 2 enemies beyond the ring.

zh: 火环与霜环交替：火环向外<kw id="Push">击退</kw>，霜环向内<kw id="Pull">吸拢</kw>。
en: Rings alternate fire, which <kw id="Push">pushes</kw> out, and frost, which <kw id="Pull">pulls</kw> in.

zh: 火环每击杀一个敌人，就放出一只烬犬，扑向最近的敌人并爆炸。
en: Each ring kill releases a cinder hound that runs at the nearest enemy and explodes.

zh: 每第 3 圈火环白炽：必定<kw id="Crit">暴击</kw>，<kw id="Overkill">多余伤害</kw>会炸开。
en: Every 3rd ring is white-hot: sure <kw id="Crit">crits</kw>, and <kw id="Overkill">overkill</kw> bursts.

zh: 火环跟随你，每次冲刺都炸出一圈；移动时火环间隔减半。
en: Rings follow you and burst on every dash; they come twice as fast while you move.

zh: 每秒有电流沿<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>的一线奔过。
en: Current runs along the <kw id="Freeze">Frozen</kw> line every second.

zh: 解冻时，整条冰线在蒸汽爆炸中炸开。
en: When it thaws, the whole line bursts in a steam explosion.

zh: 整条冰线被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>并遭追踪；解冻时生命低于 30% 的敌人被<kw id="Execute">斩杀</kw>。
en: The line is <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> and hunted; at the thaw, any below 30% are <kw id="Execute">executed</kw>.

zh: 穿过冰线的子弹变成<kw id="ChargedShot">蓄能弹</kw>：伤害 ×2 并<kw id="Pierce">穿透</kw>。
en: Rounds passing through the line become <kw id="ChargedShot">charged</kw>: ×2 and <kw id="Pierce">piercing</kw>.

zh: 沿冰线冲刺会<kw id="Shatter">碎裂</kw>沿途的敌人；每碎裂 10 个返还一次冲刺。
en: Dashing along the line <kw id="Shatter">shatters</kw> what you pass; every 10 shattered refunds a dash.

zh: 每次<kw id="Execute">斩杀</kw>都放出电弧，标记并感电最近的 3 个敌人。
en: Each <kw id="Execute">execution</kw> arcs to the 3 nearest, Marking and Shocking them.

zh: 被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>的敌人<kw id="Burn">灼烧</kw>，被斩杀时爆炸。
en: <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> enemies <kw id="Burn">Burn</kw> and explode when executed.

zh: 被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>的敌人被慢慢拖向你并<kw id="Chill">减速</kw>；冻结的敌人更早被斩杀。
en: <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> enemies are dragged toward you and <kw id="Chill">Chilled</kw>; Frozen ones die sooner.

zh: 结束时，每个被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>的敌人挨一道光矛，伤害等于它已损失的生命。
en: At the end, each <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> enemy takes a lance equal to its missing health.

zh: 冲刺穿过生命低于 50% 的被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>敌人时将其<kw id="Execute">斩杀</kw>，并返还冲刺。
en: Dashing through a <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> enemy below 50% <kw id="Execute">executes</kw> it and refunds the dash.

zh: 光束每 0.25 秒分出一道闪电。
en: Lightning branches off the beam every 0.25 s.

zh: 光束留下持续 6 秒的<kw id="Field">燃烧沟壑</kw>。
en: The beam leaves a <kw id="Field">burning trench</kw> for 6 s.

zh: 光束所过之处<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>，结束时全部碎裂。
en: The beam <kw id="Freeze">freezes</kw> what it passes and shatters it all at its end.

zh: 光束弯向被<kw id="Mark">标记</kw>的敌人和精英。
en: The beam bends toward <kw id="Mark">Marked</kw> enemies and elites.

zh: 光束随你移动，冲刺会延长持续时间。
en: The beam moves with you, and dashes extend it.

zh: 每次冲刺留下静电，慢动作结束时全部释放。
en: Each dash leaves static; it all discharges when the slow-motion ends.

zh: 每次冲刺落地都<kw id="Slam">重砸</kw>出一圈火。
en: Each dash landing <kw id="Slam">slams</kw> a ring of fire.

zh: 冲刺碰到的敌人<kw id="Freeze">冻结</kw>，慢动作结束时全部碎裂。
en: Enemies your dash touches <kw id="Freeze">freeze</kw>, and all shatter when the slow-motion ends.

zh: 每次冲刺留下一个残影，用你的武器射击直到结束。
en: Each dash leaves an afterimage that fires your weapons until the end.

zh: 结束时，每条冲刺路线都重演为一道光矛。
en: At the end, every dash line replays as a light lance.

zh: 被推到墙、冰或其他敌人身上时受到的额外伤害。
en: Pushed or pulled enemies hurt each other when they collide.

zh: 把敌人驱赶到你面前聚成密集的一堵墙，而不是让它们散开。
en: Pushes enemies into a dense wall in front of you instead of scattering them.

zh: 对精英和首领造成的伤害会被储存，每隔几秒化作光在它们身上爆发。
en: Damage to elites and bosses is stored and bursts on them as light every few seconds.

zh: 这件武器适合该流派。仅为显示提示，不改变任何数值。
en: This weapon suits the archetype. A display hint only: it changes no numbers.

zh: 第二具躯体已送回存储。
en: The second vessel is returned to storage.

zh: 独立的契约与进度。本局结束时保存。
en: Own Contracts and progress. Saved at run end.

zh: 访客躯体——不保存任何进度。
报告已保存到 {0}。请将其附在邮件或论坛帖子中。
en: Report saved to {0}. Attach it to an email or forum post.

zh: 未找到崩溃报告，无需发送。
en: No crash report found. There is nothing to send.
The report could not be saved.

zh: 游戏不会自动发送任何内容。崩溃报告会留在本机，直到你自行分享。
en: Nothing is sent automatically. Crash reports stay on this PC until you share them.
